description: The ETFs composition endpoint provides detailed information about the composition of global Exchange-Traded Funds. It returns data on the sectors included in the ETF, specific holding details, and the weighted exposure of each component. This endpoint is useful for users who need to understand the specific makeup and sector distribution of an ETF portfolio.
